module origen_145021 #(
    parameter TYPE = "DEFAULT",
    parameter DIR = "NO",
    parameter NGPIO = 32,
    parameter NVDDIO = 4,
    parameter NVSSIO = 4,
    parameter NVDD = 4,
    parameter NVSS = 4,
    parameter POC = 1,
    parameter LEFTCUT = 1,
    parameter RIGHTCUT = 1
) (
    inout [NGPIO-1:0] pad,
    inout [NVDDIO-1:0] vddio,
    inout [NVSSIO-1:0] vssio,
    inout [NVDD-1:0] vdd,
    inout [NVSS-1:0] vss,
    inout poc,
    input [NGPIO-1:0] dout,
    output [NGPIO-1:0] din,
    input [NGPIO-1:0] oen,
    input [NGPIO-1:0] ie,
    input [NGPIO*8-1:0] cfg
);

    // IO buffers
    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < NGPIO; i = i + 1) begin : io_buffers
            io_buffer #(
                .TYPE(TYPE),
                .DIR(DIR)
            ) io_buf (
                .pad(pad[i]),
                .dout(dout[i]),
                .din(din[i]),
                .oen(oen[i]),
                .ie(ie[i]),
                .cfg(cfg[i*8 +: 8])
            );
        end
    endgenerate

    // IO supply pads
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < NVDDIO; i = i + 1) begin : vddio_pads
            io_supply_pad vddio_pad (
                .pad(vddio[i])
            );
        end
    endgenerate

    // IO ground pads
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < NVSSIO; i = i + 1) begin : vssio_pads
            io_ground_pad vssio_pad (
                .pad(vssio[i])
            );
        end
    endgenerate

    // Core supply pads
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < NVDD; i = i + 1) begin : vdd_pads
            core_supply_pad vdd_pad (
                .pad(vdd[i])
            );
        end
    endgenerate

    // Core ground pads
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < NVSS; i = i + 1) begin : vss_pads
            core_ground_pad vss_pad (
                .pad(vss[i])
            );
        end
    endgenerate

    // Left cut cell
    if (LEFTCUT) begin : left_cut
        cut_cell left_cut_cell();
    end

    // Right cut cell
    if (RIGHTCUT) begin : right_cut
        cut_cell right_cut_cell();
    end

    // Power-on control cell
    if (POC) begin : poc_cell
        power_on_control poc_inst (
            .pad(poc)
        );
    end

endmodule

Agent entry point — start here

Runner-assembled entry point. This package does not retain an exact starting instruction file. The input/output and stage panels below describe the task; the evaluation runner’s saved prompt and visible-file manifest identify the actual entry point. A case manifest or private reference file is not an agent starting instruction.

A stored instruction is distinct from the runtime launch message, which can add framing and execution limits. The agent uses the harness’s file-reading tools to inspect available inputs. The file list also includes human-review reference and oracle assets that must not be given to the evaluated agent.
